design: reports/plans/2026-10-21_plan_cancellation-complement.md (approved classes 1 and 4; the named next step of reports/analyses/2026-10-21_analysis_cancellation.md)

gates.rule: first batch, W0 first then every state: KL(fp32 masked forward || hooks at the adversary's fractions of alive new pieces, dead subcomponents and Delta') <= 0.0001; hooks at zero weight give KL <= 1e-06; at W0 also F_adv <= 1e-06 and |F_both - F_orig| <= 1e-06

gates.if_fail: stop: rows or code differ from E17
gates.rule: F_adv and the bf16 adversary KL within 25% of E17's (0.00149, 0.7286)

predictions.blind_to: which originals; R is a remainder
predictions.null: O < 0.5 X: the excess sits in the interaction I or in R (dead subcomponents, Delta')
predictions.pass: O >= 0.5 X on every scored state
predictions.predicted: pass, moderate confidence: F_adv <= 0.07 X there and the changes are small beside the originals

predictions.null: F_orig about F_orig_perm: any removal of that size does the damage
predictions.pass: F_orig >= 2 x mean F_orig_perm on every scored state
predictions.predicted: pass: turning every maskable subcomponent down together costs a fiftieth of the adversary's mask (reports/analyses/2026-10-20_analysis_adversarial-vs-stochastic.md)

predictions.blind_to: cross-bin interaction; the state's own importance
predictions.pass: sum of max(e_b, 0) over imp0 and imp1 >= 0.5 x the sum over all four importance bins, on >= 3 of 4 scored states
predictions.predicted: pass, low confidence: g near 0 makes a subcomponent removable everywhere, and minimality made it inert only on W0's activations

reported_not_scored: the decomposition on ct emoticon, r1_t588_v452, r2_t359_v816 and the adjoint (X small; parts in nats); per-layer e_b (expected: largest share in layer 0 or 3); removed_b at each state and W0 (expected imp0 highest, state within 0.1 of W0 per bin); F_all against the bf16 adversary KL

setup.blind_to: Pile rows only; KL is not additive (I, R and cross-bin effects absorb it); importance bins are W0's; R lumps the dead subcomponents, Delta' and their interaction; each model under its own adversary; one adversary seed
setup.noise: one adversary seed (E11 f = 0.075, about 0.05 nats at W0); spread over 3 permutations; C0's gap to E17; per-bin differences under 0.05 nats are noise
setup.numbers: w = (1 - g)(1 - a) per alive subcomponent and position. F_all = KL(state || fp32 masked forward); X = F_all(s) - F_all(W0). Reverts of w (cancel.Remover): F_orig (alive originals, changes kept), F_adv (changes, originals kept), F_both (new pieces); O = F_orig(s) - F_orig(W0), I = F_both - F_orig - F_adv, R = [F_all - F_both](s) - [F_all - F_orig](W0), so X = O + F_adv + I + R exactly. F_orig_perm: a permuted among each matrix's alive subcomponents, 3 draws. e_b = F_orig_b(s) - F_orig_b(W0) for 4 equal-count bins of W0's mean importance (round-1 alive.pt, imp0 lowest) and per layer; removed_b = mean w per bin
setup.rows: Pile val rows 0..128 in batches of 8; every KL fp32; the adversary is gamma.pgd_sources (20 steps of 0.1, seed 0, one source per matrix over all rows) at W0 and at each state
setup.states: W0 and E17's eight: component training at step 10 (seed 0) on emoticon, r0_t352_v310, r1_t534_v369, r1_t588_v452, r2_t275_v2667, r2_t359_v816; the least-squares and scaled adjoint splits of the emoticon fine-tune's delta-W (commute.saved_states, as E17)
